steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ branch: s.status ? s.status.branch.name : null, defaultBranch: s.defaultBranch, visible: window.__gitgood.actions.tidyBranchVisible(), reason: window.__gitgood.actions.tidyBranchDisabledReason(null) }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.tidyBranch(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); if (s.rebase.preflight && !s.rebase.preflightLoading) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ dialogOpen: s.dialog ? s.dialog.kind : null, count: s.rebase.preflight ? s.rebase.preflight.count : null, pushedCount: s.rebase.preflight ? s.rebase.preflight.pushedCount : null, hasMergeCommit: s.rebase.preflight ? s.rebase.preflight.hasMergeCommit : null, resolvedBase: s.rebase.preflight ? s.rebase.preflight.resolvedBase : null }); })()

(async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.proposeRebasePlan(); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); if (!s.rebase.planLoading && (s.rebase.plan || s.rebase.planError)) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const plan = s.rebase.plan; return JSON.stringify({ planError: s.rebase.planError, rowCount: plan ? plan.rows.length : null, rowActions: plan ? plan.rows.map((r) => r.action) : null, alreadyTidy: window.__gitgood.actions.rebaseAlreadyTidy(plan), canApply: window.__gitgood.actions.canApplyRebasePlan(plan) }); })()

(async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.applyRebasePlan(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); if (!s.rebase.applying) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('history'); await window.__gitgood.actions.loadHistory(true); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ applyError: s.rebase.applyError, dialogClosed: !s.dialog, historyCount: s.history.commits.length, summaries: s.history.commits.map((c) => c.summary) }); })()

(async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.undoRebasePlan(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('history'); await window.__gitgood.actions.loadHistory(true); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ historyCount: s.history.commits.length, summaries: s.history.commits.map((c) => c.summary) }); })()
